title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-witness provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, and publication evidence.

Version 0.2.6 adds six coherent P22 modules with 46 declarations: a greatest-selected-coefficient bridge, one-stage equation-(33) descent, integral localization numerators, finite equation-(33) iteration, the full conditional cutoff-one equation-(33) witness for the selected Smith coefficient, and compatible integral numerators for that coefficient and the finite product of selected Smith coefficients. The product numerator inherits a nonzero full lift and a cutoff-one witness while retaining the localized product-divides-power bound. P22 now has 557 canonical declarations across the base and 35 support modules, and the verified graph has 50 direct Noether targets plus two umbrellas.

Cutoff 1 is source stage i = 2. The selected-coefficient product numerator is not identified with Hentzelt's primitive historical R^(2), a resultant, a normalized or canonical form, or a choice-independent object. The later-stage witness family, historical R^(i) forms, determinant-norm/resultant identification, primitive descent, compatible zeros, and multiplicity conclusions remain open. Lean verification certifies only formal statements and explicit assumptions; it does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
